## Data Preparation

```{r}

df <- read_csv(
  "data/cleaned_panel_2021_2025.csv",
  col_types = cols(city_code = col_character(), .default = col_guess()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
ncol_bldg <- ncol(df) - 6
colnames(df)[4:ncol_bldg] <- c(
  "all_type_building_count_total",
  "all_type_building_area",
  "living_count",
  "living_area",
  "dormitory_count",
  "dormitory_area",
  "mixed_use_count",
  "mixed_use_area",
  "agri_count",
  "agri_area",
  "mining_count",
  "mining_area",
  "plant_count",
  "plant_area",
  "energy_count",
  "energy_area",
  "it_count",
  "it_area",
  "logis_count",
  "logis_area",
  "retail_count",
  "retail_area",
  "finance_count",
  "finance_area",
  "real_estate_count",
  "real_estate_area",
  "hotel_count",
  "hotel_area",
  "education_count",
  "education_area",
  "health_count",
  "health_area",
  "other_service_count",
  "other_service_area",
  "official_count",
  "official_area",
  "other_type_count",
  "other_type_area"
)

```
